name: reg
description: Reverse-engineer growth: see something that's working and find out why. Three skills: competitor-funnel (how any company gets and keeps customers: its ads and where they lead, sign-up, pricing, upsells), creator-growth (how a creator grew without ads, platform by platform over time, and a plan to copy) and content-plan (a weekly brief and post drafts modelled on what's working). From public evidence, with the evidence for every finding and a list of what couldn't be seen.
